examples.japanese: {中華鍋|ちゅうかなべ}で{炒|いた}める。
{中華鍋|ちゅうかなべ}を{強火|つよび}で{熱|ねっ}してから{油|あぶら}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Heat the wok on high flame, then add oil.

examples.japanese: {鉄製|てつせい}の{中華鍋|ちゅうかなべ}は{使|つか}い{込|こ}むほど{油|あぶら}が{馴染|なじ}んで{焦|こ}げつきにくくなる。
examples.english: An iron wok becomes more seasoned with use and less prone to sticking.

notes:
A round-bottomed, high-sided cooking pan used for stir-frying and other high-heat Chinese-style cooking. Standard equipment in Japanese home kitchens for making {炒|いた}め{物|もの} (stir-fry) and {焼|や}きそば.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中華鍋|ちゅうかなべ}で{炒|いた}める: to stir-fry in a wok
- {中華鍋|ちゅうかなべ}を{振|ふ}る: to toss a wok
- {鉄製|てつせい}の{中華鍋|ちゅうかなべ}: iron wok

SIMILAR WORDS:
- フライパン: frying pan — flat-bottomed; used for Western-style frying and sautéing
- {鍋|なべ}: pot, pan — general term for any cooking pot or pan
- {土鍋|どなべ}: clay pot — used for {鍋|なべ}{料理|りょうり} (hot pot dishes), not for stir-frying
